Our revenues are generated primarily by life insurance premiums and investment income from invested assets.

Total revenues decreased in the three months ended March 31, 2025 as compared to the prior year period. Despite the increase in both first year and renewal premiums, revenues decreased due to the Blackrock material adjustment in valuation, which led to a $3.9 million decrease in investment related gains (losses) which was mostly non-cash.

Our first year direct premiums increased 49% in the three months ended March 31, 2025, compared to the same period in 2024, due to sales of our newer products in our Life Insurance segment and expanded domestic distribution. intro.text: Incorporated in Colorado and based in Austin, Texas, Citizens, Inc. ("Citizens" or the "Company") is an insurance holding company. Since 1969 it has addressed the life insurance needs of people in the United States, and since 1975, it has extended life insurance offerings to clients worldwide. Through our international insurance subsidiary, we provide insurance benefits to residents in over 80 different countries, and through our domestic insurance subsidiaries, we are licensed to issue insurance products in 43 U.S. states. We pursue a strategy of offering insurance products in niche markets where we believe we are able to achieve competitive advantages. We had approximately $1.8 billion of assets and over $5.4 billion of direct insurance in force at December 31, 2025.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: Because insurance premiums are the primary source of our revenues, our overall financial performance depends primarily upon the successful development, distribution and persistency of our products.

As described above, we sell our policies to residents of foreign countries through independent marketing agencies and independent consultants located in those countries and we rely on our independent consultants to comply with laws applicable to them in marketing and servicing our insurance products in their respective countries.
Our long‑term success depends on the strength, engagement, and integrity of our people.
We rely on our independent consultants to comply with laws applicable to them in marketing and servicing our insurance products in their respective countries.
We rely on a small number of foreign agencies that recruit their own independent consultants for distribution of our international products.
Pricing accuracy depends upon our ability to project future losses based on historical loss experience, adjusted for known trends.

Citizens is a holding company that has minimal operations of its own and depends on the ability of our insurance subsidiaries to pay dividends or make service payments to us in sufficient amounts to fund our operations.
The realization of the deferred tax assets depends on the existence of sufficient taxable income in either the carry back or carry forward periods under applicable tax law.
We are continuously enhancing our system and processes and we are licensing new systems as our business depends on our ability to maintain and improve our technology.
As mentioned above, we rely on our technology systems to operate our business.
Since our investments are one of two principal sources of our revenues, we describe them in detail.
Our investments are an integral part of our business success, as we invest the majority of premiums collected to pay for future benefits and rely on net investment income for our ongoing operations.
